name: CPX-351 (Liposomal Cytarabine-Daunorubicin)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
Tumor-lysis prophylaxis: hydration and allopurinol (or rasburicase if high risk); monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid.
Expect prolonged cytopenias; give full infection prophylaxis and transfusion support.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.
LVEF for anthracycline (liposomal daunorubicin still contributes to cumulative exposure).

drugs.name: Cytarabine (liposomal, CPX-351)
drugs.notes: Liposomal fixed-ratio (5:1) cytarabine 100 units/m2 IV over 90 min on days 1, 3 and 5 for first induction (days 1 and 3 for second induction and consolidation), for therapy-related AML or AML with myelodysplasia-related changes. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Daunorubicin (liposomal, CPX-351)
drugs.notes: Liposomal fixed-ratio (5:1) daunorubicin 44 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 3 and 5 (days 1 and 3 for second induction/consolidation), paired with liposomal cytarabine as CPX-351. Track cumulative anthracycline exposure. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
